verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a payment rail with a software channel (Batch Provider), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a test environment, test credentials, or a way to submit payments without moving real funds. The only programmatic channel mentioned is the Batch Provider Software, with no test mode described, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
